mechanism: Azathioprine causes immunosuppression and increases infection risk; amikacin is nephrotoxic and both agents can compromise renal function, potentially increasing amikacin accumulation and toxicity.
action: Monitor renal function (creatinine, BUN) closely and adjust amikacin dosing based on renal clearance; consider alternative antibiotics if possible; monitor for signs of infection given azathioprine-induced immunosuppression.
